evals.name: Publisher ID & Script Placement
evals.prompt: Embed Google AdSense publisher script in document head with async execution and configure a responsive ad unit with client ID.
evals.expected_output: Injects official adsbygoogle.js script tag with ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX syntax and responsive ins container.
assertions: Loads adsbygoogle.js asynchronously in document head
Includes crossorigin='anonymous' attribute on script tag
Validates 16-digit publisher account syntax (ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)
Configures responsive ad unit with data-ad-client and data-ad-slot

evals.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) Prevention
evals.prompt: Design CSS layout wrapper for an AdSense banner to reserve height dynamically and prevent Core Web Vitals CLS layout shifts.
evals.expected_output: Reserves container space using CSS min-height to eliminate content displacement when asynchronous ads render.
assertions: Declares explicit CSS min-height reservation on ad wrapper containers
Wraps ins.adsbygoogle in responsive container element
Prevents unreserved 0px starting heights during asynchronous rendering
Supports responsive leaderboard and mobile banner dimensions

evals.name: ads.txt Authorization & Mandatory Legal Disclosures
evals.prompt: Configure root ads.txt with Google canonical TAG ID and establish required Privacy Policy disclosures for third-party cookie usage.
evals.expected_output: Deploys compliant ads.txt file and publishes Privacy Policy disclosing Google AdSense, cookies, and opt-out mechanisms.
assertions: Deploys root ads.txt with format 'google.com, pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0'
Discloses Google third-party vendor advertising in Privacy Policy
Explains DART cookie usage for personalized ad targeting
Provides direct user opt-out links to Google Ads Settings

evals.name: Measurement ID & Subdomain Data Stream Isolation
evals.prompt: Configure GA4 for a multi-service platform where app, tools, and marketing sites reside on separate subdomains without cross-traffic pollution.
evals.expected_output: Configures isolated Web Data Streams with dedicated G-XXXXXXXXXX IDs and loads gtag.js asynchronously.
assertions: Loads gtag.js asynchronously via official googletagmanager.com URL
Configures dedicated Measurement ID per subdomain without cross-stream pollution
Initializes global dataLayer array and gtag helper function safely
Uses valid GA4 Measurement ID syntax matching G-[A-Z0-9]+

evals.name: SPA Route Tracking & Duplicate Pageview Prevention
evals.prompt: Integrate GA4 in an Angular Single Page Application, preventing duplicate initial pageviews and capturing client-side route transitions.
evals.expected_output: Disables automatic page_view in initial config and dispatches page_view events on router navigation completion.
assertions: Configures send_page_view: false in initial gtag config call
Subscribes to router navigation events to track SPA view transitions
Dispatches explicit page_view event with page_path and page_title
Guards analytics service against server-side rendering execution

evals.name: Custom Event Taxonomy & PII Redaction
evals.prompt: Implement custom event tracking for user actions while enforcing snake_case naming conventions and strictly preventing PII transmission.
evals.expected_output: Emits valid custom events adhering to length and naming constraints while redacting passwords, emails, and sensitive tokens.
assertions: Enforces snake_case event names within 40-character length boundary
Avoids reserved Google prefixes (_/ga_/google_/firebase_)
Strips passwords, auth tokens, and plaintext emails from event parameters
Wraps gtag calls with defensive runtime existence checks

evals.name: Canonical Link Tag & URL Normalization
evals.prompt: Implement canonical link tag strategy for apex domain vs subdomain routing, preventing duplicate content penalties in Google Search Console.
evals.expected_output: Injects link rel=canonical with absolute canonical URL, strips tracking query parameters, and ensures self-referencing subdomains.
assertions: Renders explicit <link rel='canonical' href='...'> in document head
Enforces single apex domain vs www hostname consistency
Configures self-referencing canonical URL on subdomains
Strips dynamic UTM and tracking query parameters from canonical URL

evals.name: XML Sitemap & Robots.txt Directives
evals.prompt: Generate a compliant sitemap.xml with prioritized URLs and configure robots.txt referencing the public sitemap endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Creates valid XML sitemap with lastmod, changefreq, and priority tags, and exposes Sitemap directive in robots.txt.
assertions: Defines valid XML sitemap structure conforming to sitemaps.org schema
Assigns priority tiers (1.0 for home, 0.8 for tools, 0.3 for legal)
Configures robots.txt referencing absolute sitemap URL
Disallows crawler indexing of private administrative and API routes

evals.name: JSON-LD WebApplication Schema Rich Snippet
evals.prompt: Embed structured Schema.org JSON-LD structured data into the HTML head for a WebApplication entity with licensing and author metadata.
evals.expected_output: Injects application/ld+json script tag with valid Schema.org WebApplication or SoftwareApplication structure.
assertions: Embeds script type='application/ld+json' in document head
Declares Schema.org context and WebApplication or SoftwareApplication type
Provides application name, url, description, and operatingSystem properties
Includes author or creator entity metadata
